description.value: Co-op Ucluelet Food & Hardware is a community-owned co-operative supermarket and hardware store on the main commercial strip of Ucluelet, a remote surf and hiking town on the west coast of Vancouver Island. As the primary full-service grocery option in a small, geographically isolated community, it is a key resupply point for cyclists riding the Pacific Rim or doing the West Coast route. Being a member-owned co-op, it has deep local roots and an emphasis on community connection.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, locally-owned co-operative in Ucluelet, with a 2025 Annual General Meeting listed, active careers and membership pages, and no closure signals. The OSM tag shop=supermarket and the name 'Food & Hardware' confirm grocery and hardware retail; however, the website rendered as a heavily JavaScript-templated shell with almost no substantive content, so amenity details beyond basic groceries cannot be verified from the website. No bike parking, water refill, or any other cycling-specific amenity is mentioned in either source.
concerns: Website rendered almost entirely as unresolved JavaScript template variables (${title}, ${loading}, component IDs); substantive content such as contact details, hours, and department listings did not load, making amenity verification impossible from the website.
OSM name is 'Co-op Ucluelet Food & Hardware' but the website branding reads 'Ucluelet Co-op' — minor name discrepancy worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating community supermarket and hardware store in a remote coastal community; a critical resupply stop for touring cyclists on the west coast of Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: community-owned co-operative... primary full-service grocery option in a small, geographically isolated community
